annotations.title: Batch-renumber placed rooms on one level in a single Revit t

description: Batch-renumber placed rooms on one level in a single Revit transaction. Sorts by room center from top to bottom, then left to right, using a configurable Y-row tolerance. Supports dry-run preview and starts from a seed such as B134.

allowExistingNumberConflicts.description: Allow proposed numbers even when the same room numbers already exist outside the target level.

dryRun.description: true previews the planned order without writing to Revit.

includeUnnamed.description: Whether unnamed placed rooms should be included.

level.description: Level name or unambiguous partial level name, e.g. B1F or C-B1F.

parameterName.description: Optional explicit room number parameter name. If omitted, the Revit built-in room number parameter is used.

startNumber.description: First room number to assign, e.g. B134. The trailing digit width is preserved.

yToleranceMm.description: Y-axis grouping tolerance in millimeters for row detection.

name: renumber_rooms_by_level
